title: Contextual Observer Grounding: Evaluating Situated Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.06880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning over language instructions in embodied tasks such as robotics often requires understanding spatial relations from a speaker's situated perspective. Humans infer such perspectives from shared environmental knowledge, activity context, and commonsense. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) appear capable of spatial reasoning, but their ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and interpret situated spatial relations from that viewpoint remains unclear. We call this capability contextual observer grounding. To study this capability, we construct the Point-of-View Benchmark (POVBench), a dataset of 3D scenes and queries that disentangles Inferred, Stated, and Given forms of observer grounding in natural embodied communication. Given multi-view observations and a natural-language sentence, models must localize unseen or underspecified targets from situated spatial and contextual cues. Across state-of-the-art VLMs

translated_title: 情境观察者定位：评估视觉语言模型中的情境化空间推理
translated_abstract: 在机器人等具身任务中对语言指令进行推理，通常需要从说话者所处的视角理解空间关系。人类会从共享的环境知识、活动情境和常识中推断这种视角。最近的视觉语言模型（VLMs）似乎具备空间推理能力，但它们从情境线索中推断说话者视角、并从该视角解释情境化空间关系的能力仍不清楚。我们将这种能力称为情境观察者定位。为了研究这种能力，我们构建了视角基准（POVBench），这是一个由3D场景和查询组成的数据集，它将自然具身交流中推断型、陈述型和给定型三种观察者定位形式加以区分。给定多视角观察和一句自然语言句子，模型必须根据情境化的空间和上下文线索来定位未见过或未明确指定的目标。在多个最先进的VLM上……
tldr: 该论文提出“情境观察者定位”这一新能力概念，并构建了POVBench基准，用于评估视觉语言模型从情境线索推断说话者视角并进行情境化空间推理的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "contextual observer grounding" and constructs POVBench, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language models' ability to infer a speaker's viewpoint from contextual cues and perform situated spatial reasoning.
